summary: Rubico Inc., a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, attaching a press release announcing its unaudited financial results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The release reports a net loss of $1.1 million, revenues of $9.7 million, cash and equivalents of $11.6 million, total assets of $149.8 million, and stockholders' equity of $50.5 million. Management commentary focuses on operational performance, drydocking costs, and future fleet expansion. No special-situation transaction, such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring, is described. The filing is a routine periodic earnings report, not a special situation.
